title: June W Possible NDE 8052
content: I was rushed by ambulance and immediately into the resuscitation room. I had a lot of pressure, pain, and blood loss. They found it difficult to find veins for IVs and blood drawing because my veins had collapsed. I was aware of everything going that was happening. I was able to give them details of my operation and what medications I was taking. After they cut my nightie and underwear off, because they were completely soaked in blood, I begged them to let my husband in the room. I needed to make sure he didn't frighten my pregnant daughter with the news since she had high blood pressure. At this stage, my blood pressure was very low and my heart rate very high. I held my husband's hand, looked up into his face, told him that things were really bad and that I was 'going.' He tried to be reassuring but I felt I was slipping away. I told him I loved him and then everything went black. Quickly after that, I saw white light but was not aware of any sound or of medical staff taking him out of the room. My husband told me that as soon as I told him that I was going, my arm and leg fell off trolley and my eyes were fixed open. The next thing I remember was a heavy weight on my chest as if someone was sitting on it. My head was pushed back and the oxygen mask held very tightly on my face by someone. I felt like I was going a hundred miles an hour on the trolley along a corridor. I briefly remember giving my date of birth in the operating room.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: After everything went black and she saw white light, she next remembered physical sensations of being managed by staff ("heavy weight on my chest," head pushed back, oxygen mask held tightly) and being moved rapidly on a trolley along a corridor.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe blood loss with very low blood pressure and very high heart rate; resuscitation room and operating room mentioned.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Loss of consciousness/blackness followed by seeing white light; then return to intense physical sensations and rapid movement on a trolley.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She reports being aware of everything in the resuscitation room prior to "everything went black," then seeing "white light" without sound, followed by strong physical sensations ("heavy weight on my chest," oxygen mask held tightly) and rapid movement on a trolley.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I told him that things were really bad and that I was ‘going.’” / “then everything went black. Quickly after that, I saw white light but was not aware of any sound” / “a heavy weight on my chest as if someone was sitting on it.”
